data_sources.name: noaa_psl_narr
data_sources.label: NOAA PSL NARR daily products
data_sources.producer_institution: NOAA NCEP; NOAA Physical Sciences Laboratory
data_sources.description: Daily derivatives of NCEP NARR. All 87 variables enumerated by the current R narr_variable helper have freshly inspected provider DAS metadata. The workbook claim that the archive ended around 2021 is superseded by current PSL documentation. Daily means and daily sums are not native three-hourly instantaneous products; native statistic and vertical support govern each binding.
data_sources.citation_apa: Mesinger et al. (2006). North American Regional Reanalysis. Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society 87, 343–360. https://doi.org/10.1175/BAMS-87-3-343. NCEP NARR data provided by NOAA PSL, Boulder, Colorado, USA.

products.name: narr_psl_daily_surface
products.label: NARR PSL daily surface
products.description: Native PSL daily file grouping. Source time coordinate defines the start and a one-day period; means combine native 00–21 UTC samples, while named sum fields retain their native Sum statistic. 349 × 277 Lambert grid: native x/y coordinates give nominal 32463 m spacing, distinct from a rounded 32 km or the example model spacing. CF Lambert parameters are lat_0=50, lon_0=-107, parallels 50/50, false easting 5632642.22547 m, northing 4612545.65137 m. No radius/datum is supplied in these headers; AMADEUS:100005 is an explicit unresolved placeholder, not WGS84 or a registered engine CRS. Grid coordinates and decoded values are known, but geographic transformation awaits verified earth-model metadata. TKE has 15 pressure levels, not the 29 of other pressure fields. Soil moisture has four native depth labels; soil temperature has five including 800 cm. Depth labels are not asserted as layer centres/bounds. Rewritten local fixtures are not native evidence.
products.native_spatial_resolution_descriptor: Native PSL projected coordinate spacing approximately 32.463 km
products.spatial_extent_descriptor: North American Lambert domain; coverage differs from CONUS-only products
